title: Frame buffer pool management
description: Implement frame buffer pool for efficient memory usage
notes: Implemented a fixed-capacity, allocation-free frame pool (4 x 256-byte buffers) with generation-tagged handles, stale/double-release rejection, zero-on-release, thread-safe acquire/get/release, explicit -ENOBUFS, and busy-destroy protection. Integrated TX queue entries with pool ownership across push/preemption/pop/expiry/clear/destroy and removed the unused duplicate tx_queue from lichen_link_ctx so constrained targets keep only the active radio queue's storage. Added dedicated boundary/generation/wrap/zeroization/concurrency tests and queue ownership lifecycle coverage. Validation 2026-08-27: frame_pool CTest 1/1 under UBSan; tx_queue 27/27; link_ctx CTest 1/1; scoped cppcheck clean; git diff --check clean; local Zephyr 4.1/SDK 0.16.8 modules/lichen/subsys/lichen/link/all and l2/all both built successfully (upstream Zephyr warnings only).
close_reason: Bounded static frame pool and complete TX queue ownership lifecycle implemented and validated.
